caption: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
action: twisting (wringing) something wet until water comes out
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Ensure the canvas is sufficiently wet to allow for smooth twisting without tearing.
Position the canvas vertically to facilitate gravity-assisted drips during the twisting motion.
Apply consistent pressure to twist the canvas evenly along its length to remove paint.
Allow the drips to fall freely without obstruction to achieve desired paint distribution.
